title: Spec of a ring map on points and on residue fields
statement: Let $\psi:R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\operatorname{Spec}\psi:\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')$. (1) $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ maps the point $\mathfrak p'$ to the point $\mathfrak p$. (2) Let $r:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R'}(\mathfrak p')$ be the homomorphism induced by $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ on residue fields of the schemes [def-weil-residue-field]; let $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$, $\kappa(\mathfrak p')=R'_{\mathfrak p'}/\mathfrak p'R'_{\mathfrak p'}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $\kappa(\psi):\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ the homomorphism induced by $\psi$ ($r/t\mapsto\psi(r)/\psi(t)$); and let $e_R:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, $e_{R'}:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R'}(\mathfrak p')\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ be the isomorphisms induced by the identifications of stalks $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathfrak p}\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$, $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R',\mathfrak p'}\cong R'_{\mathfrak p'}$ (as in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-residue-field-identification]). Then $e_{R'}\circ r=\kappa(\psi)\circ e_R$.
